draft_en.subject: The industrial 8-port PoE and the Dahua PoE positions on your site - neutral-brand numbers
draft_en.body:
Hello SATS Digital team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "Industrial PoE Switch" on 25 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the 8-port industrial PoE switch and the Dahua PoE positions on your site, neutral-brand units at distributor price, EXW, from single units, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, unmanaged, -40 to 75 C - model STI-288GP - $60 USD; commercial 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - STC-28DGGPM - $80.7; budget 4 x PoE+ + 2 x Gigabit - STC-204GP - $24.2.

One question: which PoE SKU sells most on your platform - the industrial 8-port or the small commercial ones?

Best regards,
Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
